exsisExperienceDescription: In my role as a Senior Consultant at Exsis Digital, I was an integral part of the vulnerabilities team. My main responsibilities included addressing application and company framework updates. This work was primarily carried out using languages such as C#, Asp.Net, jQuery, and JavaScript. We were able to resolve 95% of high vulnerabilities and 60% of low vulnerabilities. This position allowed me to apply my technical skills to solving complex software challenges while closely collaborating with other teams to ensure the security and effectiveness of implemented solutions.
coomevaExperienceDescription:
In my role as National Development Coordinator at Coomeva Medicina Prepagada, I had the privilege of leading and providing technical guidance to a highly talented team of engineers. Together, we navigated through all stages of the software development life cycle.

We excelled in implementing cutting-edge technologies such as Java, Angular, and PHP to design and develop customized solutions that addressed the needs of both our internal and external clients. As part of my primary responsibilities, I was responsible for defining and overseeing the architecture of these solutions, ensuring their alignment with the organization's strategic objectives and technological standards. Through effective management and close collaboration with the team, we successfully implemented and modernized our core business application, marking a significant milestone in our digital transformation journey. This project highlights not only my ability to lead and execute high-complexity projects but also my skill in designing robust architectures that facilitate long-term software evolution and maintenance.

Additionally, I led the creation and implementation of robust integrations with Java-based RESTful APIs for our satellite systems. This initiative significantly improved system connectivity and optimized data flow efficiency throughout the organization.

It's also worth noting a project in which we improved online revenue collection by 90%. Previously, users experienced long wait times in the revenue collection application, and this initiative effectively resolved this issue.

These experiences have strengthened my competence in creating and managing technological architectures. I am prepared to take on even greater challenges in roles as an Architect and Technical Leader, where my ability to design scalable solutions and maintain highly productive teams will be of immeasurable value.

koralatExperienceDescription:
I led the strategy to evolve the company's Core towards a modern Microservices architecture, working closely with the provider Cobis Topaz to ensure a smooth migration. I led the negotiation of technical and budgetary agreements, achieving an optimal cost-benefit balance in the adoption of AWS cloud services. I actively participated in vendor selection, running technical feasibility assessments to ensure that solutions aligned with the scalability and high availability required by the business.

I drove the adoption of clean, decoupled architectures on the technology stack (.NET Core), enabling container deployment and cloud orchestration. I designed and implemented continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) strategies using Jenkins and AWS managed services, automating processes that significantly reduced "Time-to-Market". I also led the migration from IBM API Connect to Gravitee API Manager to optimize traffic management. I coordinated multidisciplinary teams (internal and outsourcing) under agile methodologies, ensuring that the proposed architecture met the organization's security and operational efficiency standards.

• Implementation of the architecture vision for the banking Core.
• Promotion of an agile development culture, with a notable increase in team productivity and software quality.
• Leadership in the adoption of strategies for migrations and integrations with the Cobis Topaz core.
setiExperienceTitle: AI Software Architect — Generative AI & Cloud Solutions
setiExperienceDescription:
As lead architect in the AI vertical, I designed and oversaw the architecture of Pro-code and Low-code Agents aimed at solving critical use cases for Bancolombia. My focus was on enabling transversal capabilities that scaled generative AI across the organization. I applied robust design methodologies, producing Context, Container and Deployment diagrams, ensuring every solution was aligned with the bank's security standards and infrastructure.

I led the technical evaluation and execution of Proofs of Concept (PoC), analyzing new AI capabilities and emerging models to determine their viability and business impact. My role acted as a bridge between technological innovation and operational efficiency, ensuring that agent architectures were modular, maintainable and highly integrable with existing systems in the financial ecosystem.

• Design of reference architectures for intelligent agents under Pro-code and Low-code approaches.
• Detailed modeling of solutions applying the C4 standard to ensure technical clarity and alignment with stakeholders.
• Identification and development of transversal AI capabilities to optimize component reuse at the organizational level.
• Continuous research and benchmarking of new AI technologies to maintain the business's competitive edge.
projectsIntro: A curated selection of open-source projects that reflect my focus on architecture, code quality and modern engineering practices.
project_devsu_name: ProyectoDevsu — Banking microservices with async events (Java)
project_devsu_summary: Solution to the Devsu technical challenge: two Spring Boot microservices managing Clients, Accounts and Movements in a banking domain, communicating asynchronously via RabbitMQ.
project_devsu_highlights: Hexagonal Architecture, database-per-service and CQRS-lite (local replica for reporting). OAuth2/OIDC security with Keycloak, secrets in Vault, Flyway migrations. Unit, integration (Testcontainers) and E2E (Karate) tests. Documented C4 diagrams.
project_devsunet_summary: The .NET version of the Devsu banking solution, showcasing stack-agnostic polyvalence: same OpenAPI contracts, same DB schema and same shared infrastructure as the Java version.
project_devsunet_highlights: Two ASP.NET Core microservices with Hexagonal Architecture, Entity Framework Core on PostgreSQL and asynchronous messaging via RabbitMQ. Keycloak (OIDC/JWT) + Vault, tests with xUnit and Testcontainers for .NET. Designed to run side by side with the Java version on the same infrastructure.
project_cachesystem_name: Cachesystem — Distributed cache with Spring Boot and Redis
project_cachesystem_summary: Distributed cache REST API built with Spring Boot 3, Redis 7 and Hexagonal Architecture (Ports & Adapters).
project_cachesystem_highlights: Native TTL support, RFC 7807 Problem Details for errors, OpenAPI docs, integration tests with Testcontainers, multistage Docker image and CI via GitHub Actions. Designed to showcase clean separation between domain, application and infrastructure.
project_hotelbooking_name: HotelBookingSolution — Booking management with .NET and DDD
project_hotelbooking_summary: Hotel reservation management platform built with .NET Core 8 and Domain-Driven Design, with clearly separated Domain, Application, Infrastructure and API layers.
project_hotelbooking_highlights: JWT authentication, persistence with Entity Framework Core on SQL Server, containerization with Docker Compose and E2E tests with Playwright alongside xUnit/MSTest. CI/CD pipeline on GitHub Actions.
